svg.title: Diskoryx median scan and indexing time: v1.0.1 versus v1.0.3
svg.desc: Three repeated real C drive MFT scans per version on the same machine. Median time decreased from 7.951 seconds to 4.400 seconds, 44.7 percent lower. OS caches were not flushed. Lower is better.

g.text: Real C: scan. Measured, not estimated.
Median of 3 repeated MFT scans per version | Scan + indexing | Lower is better
~774,500 files | Windows 11 | i7-14650HX | NVMe SSD | NTFS | 2026-10-23
Warm/repeated runs, not cold-cache trials. Live volume counts vary. Results are not a universal speed guarantee.
